description: This source file defines the class `PhotoDecodeRunnable`, which implements `Runnable` to perform background image decoding. It includes an internal interface `TaskRunnableDecodeMethods` for interaction with the enclosing task, manages image decoding with sampling for performance, handles memory issues, and communicates state changes. The class is part of an Android project related to image processing or photo handling.

classes.name: PhotoDecodeRunnable
classes.description: A `Runnable` implementation that decodes an image from a byte array in a background thread, reporting progress and handling errors.

classes.name: PhotoDecodeRunnable.TaskRunnableDecodeMethods
classes.description: Interface for callback methods to interact with the `PhotoTask` object, including setting thread info, getting image data, handling states, and setting the decoded image.

methods.name: PhotoDecodeRunnable
methods.description: Constructor that assigns the caller `PhotoTask` object to support callback interactions.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Performs the image decoding process in a background thread, managing decoding attempts, handling interruptions, memory errors, and updating task states accordingly.
